## Long-Leg Kick

![](../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/long_leg_kick.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

A leg as long as a man swept round in front: everyone in a wide arc is kicked off their feet. Black Leg kicks hit harder.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Conditional cooldown | 5 s (100 ticks) |

</div>

## Sky Stride

![](../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/sky_stride.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

One step of a long leg is a leap far forward and up; the landing costs nothing and knocks everyone around off their feet.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Conditional cooldown | 7 s (140 ticks) |

</div>

## Heel Drop

![](../../assets/playable/hakirework/abilities/heel_drop.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy }

A long leg raised high and brought down like an axe on the one the user looks at, leaving them reeling.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">
